title: SMFs in different containers: no heartbeat error after try to discover udm

labels.name: Help Wanted
labels.description: Maintainers are not working on this issue so community help is wanted.

body:
Hello open5gs community,

I'm quite new to open5gs and I've been testing with different configurations. The basic setup testing with Ueransim worked OK, but I'm finding problems when testing with additional SMF/UPF in an additional node instance, I hope you could help me to identify what I'm misconfiguring.

Environment summary: two LxC containers dedicated to open5gs, with LAN connectivity between them:
- node 1: full open5gs SA deployment, updating yaml files in general to use LAN IPs for SBIs and other interfaces. Inclusion of specific configuration to support different TACs (amf.yaml update), and associate this SMF to TAC 1 (smf.yaml update) 
- node 2: Configuration of an additional SMF associated to TAC 2 and UPF managed by this SMF. NRF of node 1 used to register the NFs.

In addition to this, there is a third  LxC container with the UERANSIM instance, also connected via LAN.

When I register with Ueransim gNB using TAC 1, the SMF and UPF from node 1 are selected and everything goes OK (N2 interface goes up with node 1 AMF, and N3 with node 1 UPF). The issue appears with Ueransim gNB configured with TAC 2, where node 2 SMF is selected, and it shows the following logs:

```
08/24 08:44:44.123: [smf] INFO: [Added] Number of SMF-UEs is now 1 (../src/smf/context.c:883)
08/24 08:44:44.123: [smf] INFO: [Added] Number of SMF-Sessions is now 1 (../src/smf/context.c:2921)
08/24 08:44:44.123: [app] WARNING: Try to discover [UDM] (../lib/sbi/path.c:110)
08/24 08:44:48.085: [smf] ERROR: [a28825e2-2388-41ed-b6a6-0b730cb8b6af] No heartbeat (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:295)
08/24 08:44:48.085: [smf] INFO: [a28825e2-2388-41ed-b6a6-0b730cb8b6af] NF de-registered (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:232)
```
It seems that SMF in node 2 finds some issue to connect with UDM in node 1, but I have not noticed any connectivity problem between the machines (the initial registration procedure goes well). After this event, even after shutting down Ueransim, I can see an inconsistent status between SMF in node 2 and NRF in node 1, where SMF re-registers continuosly:

```
08/24 08:45:59.027: [smf] INFO: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] NF registered [Heartbeat:10s] (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:199)
08/24 09:27:50.679: [smf] ERROR: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] No heartbeat (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:295)
08/24 09:27:50.704: [smf] INFO: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] NF de-registered (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:232)
08/24 09:27:57.067: [smf] ERROR: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] HTTP Response Status Code [204] (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:135)
08/24 09:27:57.590: [smf] WARNING: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] Retry to registration with NRF (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:383)
08/24 09:27:57.590: [smf] INFO: [2cf4043a-2389-41ed-9ac8-21da032185ec] NF registered [Heartbeat:10s] (../src/smf/nf-sm.c:199)

```

Any suggestion to guide me to fix this issue?

Please find attached the complete configuration applied in both nodes: [open5gs_config.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/9414740/open5gs_config.zip)

Thanks in advance and kind regards,
José María
